title: Knight's Spectral Vow
description: A woman in a royal blue velvet gown sits barefoot on a stone floor, holding a glowing flame in her hands. Ethereal white-line ghostly knights in armor battle with swords around her, one partially merged with her flowing pinkish cloak, set against a stone archway opening to a desolate fantasy landscape at dusk.
prompt: A woman in a rich royal blue off-shoulder velvet gown sits barefoot on the floor inside a ruined stone archway, holding a bright magical flame in her cupped hands. Around her swirl translucent ghostly medieval knights in full plate armor drawn in glowing white lines, actively fighting with swords and shields in dynamic poses. One spectral knight appears to merge with her flowing pinkish translucent cloak. The background shows a barren fantasy landscape with distant pillars under a purple and orange twilight sky. Dramatic rim lighting, particles and embers floating in the air, mystical and somber atmosphere.
